sonnet.problem: Card 4 already asked whether anyone is doing good (v1: "There is no one who does good"). Card 7 asks the same fact again from v3, which repeats that line, so these two lines make the same point and should get one question.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: The question says "When the LORD's search is done," which adds a time and an outcome. Psalm 14:3 doesn't say the search finishes or that David is reporting its result.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.
